name: Streaming Skills Plugin
description: Skills for streaming application developers, covering Kafka and Flink client libraries and Schema Registry
longDescription:
Ships **10 skills**.

- **Skills** (10): `confluent-cloud-cdc-tableflow` (Set up end-to-end Change Data Capture (CDC) pipelines on Confluent Cloud using Debezium source connectors, Flink for transformation,…), `confluent-cloud-flink-sql` (Write and debug Flink SQL that runs on Confluent Cloud, enforcing the CC-vs-Apache-Flink (OSS) dialect boundary), `confluent-skill-creator` (Create Confluent-specific skills for external users), `confluent-skill-reviewer` (Review a Confluent agent skill in this repo against the Agent Skills spec (agentskills.io), Confluent conventions in CLAUDE.md,…), `developing-kafka-java-client` (Use when the user wants to integrate a Kafka client into an existing application or scaffold a Java…), `developing-kafka-python-client` (Use when the user wants to build a Python Kafka producer or consumer, add Schema Registry to existing…), `flink-udf` (Build and deploy Apache Flink user-defined functions (UDFs) in Java for stream processing over Kafka), `kafka-schema-registry` (Scan a project to identify Kafka applications, extract schemas from data models, tag PII fields, generate Terraform for…), and 2 more

Installs with `claude plugin install streaming-skills-plugin@claude-plugins-official` from `confluentinc/agent-skills`.
